<html lang="ar" dir="rtl">
<head>
  <script>document.documentElement.classList.add("js")</script>
  <link rel="icon" type="image/png" href="data:image/png;base64,">
  <meta charset="utf-8">
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1">
  <title>FARARH ACCESSORIES </title>
  <link rel="stylesheet" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Reem+Kufi:wght@500;700&family=IBM+Plex+Sans+Arabic:wght@400;500;600&display=swap">
  <style>
/* colors */

:root {
  --bg: #FAF4E7;
  --surface: #FFFDF8;
  --fg: #65300F;
  --muted: #8B735F;
  --line: #E3D4C2;
  --accent: #65300F;
  --accent-fg: #FFF9ED;
  --gold: #AE865A;
  --soft: #EDE0CE;
  --ok: #1F7A4D;
  --bad: #B3261E;

  --font-display: "Reem Kufi", "IBM Plex Sans Arabic", system-ui, sans-serif;
  --font-body: "IBM Plex Sans Arabic", system-ui, sans-serif;
}


* { box-sizing: border-box; }
body {
  margin: 0;
  background: var(--bg); color: var(--fg);
  font-family: var(--font-body); font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.6;
  padding: 0 16px 96px;
}
.wrap { max-width: 1040px; margin: 0 auto; }
h1, h2, h3 { font-family: var(--font-display); font-weight: 700; margin: 0; text-wrap: balance; line-height: 1.25; }
h2 { font-size: 1.6rem; }
p { margin: 0; }
section { padding-block: 28px; }
.sec-head { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 4px; margin-bottom: 18px; }
.sec-head p { color: var(--muted); }

.hero { padding-block: 40px 20px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 12px; }
.brand { font-family: var(--font-display); font-size: 1.1rem; color: var(--accent); letter-spacing: .02em; }
.hero h1 { font-size: clamp(2rem, 7vw, 3.4rem); max-width: 16ch; }
.hero p { color: var(--muted); max-width: 46ch; }
.hero .cta { align-self: flex-start; margin-top: 8px; }

button, .btn {
  font: inherit; cursor: pointer; border: 0; border-radius: 10px;
  background: var(--accent); color: var(--accent-fg); padding: 10px 18px; font-weight: 600;
  display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; text-decoration: none;
}
button.ghost { background: transparent; color: var(--accent); border: 1.5px solid var(--accent); }
button:disabled { opacity: .55; cursor: default; }
:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--gold); outline-offset: 2px; }

.offers { display: grid; gap: 12px; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(240px, 1fr)); }
.offer { background: var(--soft); border-radius: 14px; padding: 16px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 6px; min-width: 0; }
.offer b { font-family: var(--font-display); font-size: 1.25rem; }
.offer .tag { align-self: flex-start; font-size: .8rem; font-weight: 600; background: var(--accent); color: var(--accent-fg); padding: 2px 10px; border-radius: 99px; }

.grid { display: grid; gap: 14px; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(190px, 1fr)); }
.card { background: var(--surface); border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 14px; overflow: hidden; display: flex; flex-direction: column; min-width: 0; }
.card img { width: 100%; aspect-ratio: 1 / 1; object-fit: cover; display: block; background: var(--soft); }
.card .body { padding: 12px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 6px; flex: 1; }
.card h3 { font-size: 1.05rem; }
.card .price { color: var(--gold); font-weight: 600; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }
.card .old { color: var(--muted); text-decoration: line-through; font-weight: 400; margin-inline-start: 6px; font-size: .9rem; }
.card .actions { margin-top: auto; padding-top: 6px; }
.card .actions button { width: 100%; }
.qty { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 8px; }
.qty button { width: 40px; height: 40px; padding: 0; font-size: 1.2rem; }
.qty span { font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; font-weight: 600; }
.note { font-size: .85rem; color: var(--muted); }

.pay { display: grid; gap: 12px; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(230px, 1fr)); }
.pay .method { background: var(--surface); border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 14px; padding: 16px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 8px; min-width: 0; }
.pay .method h3 { font-size: 1.15rem; }
.pay .num { direction: ltr; text-align: left; font-size: 1.15rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: .04em; overflow-wrap: anywhere; }
.steps { margin: 18px 0 0; padding: 0; list-style: none; display: grid; gap: 8px; counter-reset: s; }
.steps li { display: flex; gap: 10px; align-items: baseline; }
.steps li::before { content: counter(s); counter-increment: s; font-family: var(--font-display); color: var(--accent); font-weight: 700; min-width: 1.4em; }

.order { background: var(--surface); border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 16px; padding: 18px; display: grid; gap: 18px; }
.cols { display: grid; gap: 14px; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(240px, 1fr)); }
.field { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 5px; min-width: 0; }
.field label { font-weight: 600; font-size: .95rem; }
input, select, textarea {
  font: inherit; color: var(--fg); background: var(--bg); border: 1.5px solid var(--line);
  border-radius: 10px; padding: 10px 12px; width: 100%; min-width: 0;
}
input[type="file"] { padding: 8px; }
textarea { min-height: 88px; resize: vertical; }
input:focus, select:focus, textarea:focus { border-color: var(--accent); outline: none; }
.summary { background: var(--soft); border-radius: 12px; padding: 14px; display: grid; gap: 6px; }
.summary .row { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; gap: 12px; }
.summary .row span:last-child { font-weight: 600; }
.summary .total { font-family: var(--font-display); font-size: 1.25rem; border-top: 1px dashed var(--line); padding-top: 8px; margin-top: 4px; }
.summary .dep { color: var(--accent); font-weight: 700; }
.items-list { display: grid; gap: 4px; }
.items-list .row { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; gap: 10px; }
.promo { display: flex; gap: 8px; }
.promo input { direction: ltr; text-align: left; }
.promo button { white-space: nowrap; }
.preview { max-width: 220px; border-radius: 10px; border: 1px solid var(--line); display: none; }
.msg { padding: 12px 14px; border-radius: 10px; font-weight: 500; }
.msg.ok { background: #e3f4ea; color: var(--ok); }
.msg.bad { background: #fbe9e7; color: var(--bad); }
@media (prefers-color-scheme: dark) { .msg.ok { background: #1c3328; } .msg.bad { background: #3a1f1d; } }
.err { color: var(--bad); font-size: .85rem; min-height: 1.1em; }
pre.fallback { white-space: pre-wrap; background: var(--bg); color: var(--fg); border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 10px; padding: 12px; margin: 8px 0 0; font-family: var(--font-body); font-size: .9rem; font-weight: 400; }
.msg .btn, .msg button { margin-top: 8px; margin-inline-end: 8px; }


/* FARARH Shopping Cart */

.bar {
  position: fixed;
  bottom: 18px;
  left: 50%;
  right: auto;
  transform: translateX(-50%);
  width: min(92%, 780px);
  z-index: 100;
  background: #FFFDF8;
  border: 1px solid #E3D4C2;
  border-radius: 20px;
  padding: 12px 18px;
  box-shadow: 0 8px 30px rgba(101, 48, 15, 0.12);
  direction: ltr;
}

.bar .in.fararh-cart-inner {
  display: flex;
  justify-content: space-between;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 16px;
  width: 100%;
  max-width: none;
}

.cart-info {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 14px;
  min-width: 0;
}

.cart-icon {
  background: #EDE0CE;
  color: #65300F;
  width: 48px;
  height: 48px;
  display: grid;
  place-items: center;
  border-radius: 12px;
  font-size: 23px;
  flex-shrink: 0;
}

.cart-details {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 2px;
  min-width: 0;
}

.cart-details strong {
  color: #65300F;
  font-family: Georgia, serif;
  font-size: 17px;
}

.cart-details span {
  color: #65300F;
  font-size: 13px;
}

.cart-details small {
  color: #8B735F;
  font-size: 12px;
}

.cart-checkout {
  background: #65300F;
  color: #FFFDF8;
  padding: 12px 24px;
  border-radius: 30px;
  text-decoration: none;
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  gap: 10px;
  font-size: 14px;
  font-weight: 600;
  white-space: nowrap;
}

.cart-checkout:hover {
  background: #84502D;
  color: white;
}

body {
  padding-bottom: 115px;
}

@media (max-width: 600px) {
  .bar {
    width: calc(100% - 20px);
    bottom: 10px;
    padding: 10px;
    border-radius: 16px;
  }

  .cart-icon {
    width: 38px;
    height: 38px;
    font-size: 18px;
  }

  .cart-info {
    gap: 8px;
  }

  .cart-checkout {
    padding: 11px 14px;
    font-size: 12px;
  }

  .cart-details strong {
    font-size: 14px;
  }

  .cart-details small {
    font-size: 11px;
  }
}

footer { padding-block: 24px; color: var(--muted); font-size: .9rem; }
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference) { .card { transition: transform .15s; } .card:hover { transform: translateY(-2px); } }


/* FARARH Brand Logo */

.brand-header {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 15px;
  margin-bottom: 20px;
}

.logo {
  width: 85px;
  height: 85px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  object-fit: contain;
}

.brand {
  color: #65300F;
  font-size: 22px;
  font-weight: 700;
  letter-spacing: 1px;
}

/* Elegant buttons */

.btn, button {
  border-radius: 8px;
  transition: 0.3s ease;
}

.btn:hover, button:hover:not(:disabled) {
  background: #84502D;
  color: #FFF9ED;
}

/* Product cards */

.card {
  border-radius: 16px;
  box-shadow: 0 4px 18px rgba(101, 48, 15, 0.06);
}

/* Main heading */

.hero h1 {
  color: #65300F;
  font-size: clamp(2rem, 5vw, 3rem);
}


/* FARARH - New Homepage */

.hero {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 55px;
  padding: 65px 0;
  min-height: 520px;
}

.hero-content {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  align-items: flex-start;
  gap: 16px;
  text-align: right;
  min-width: 0;
}

.hero-label {
  color: #AE865A;
  font-size: 13px;
  letter-spacing: 3px;
  font-weight: 600;
}

.hero h1.hero-title {
  font-family: Georgia, serif;
  font-size: clamp(32px, 4vw, 58px);
  line-height: 1.15;
  max-width: none;
  color: #65300F;
  text-align: left;
}

.hero-title span {
  color: #AE865A;
}

.hero p.hero-subtitle {
  font-family: Georgia, serif;
  color: #65300F;
  font-size: 21px;
  font-style: italic;
  text-align: left;
  max-width: none;
}

.hero p.hero-description {
  color: #8B735F;
  font-size: 16px;
  max-width: 420px;
}

.hero .cta {
  background: #65300F;
  color: #FFFDF8;
  padding: 13px 32px;
  border-radius: 30px;
  margin-top: 12px;
}

.hero-image {
  width: 100%;
  height: 440px;
  background: #EDE0CE;
  border-radius: 180px 180px 16px 16px;
  overflow: hidden;
}

.hero-image img {
  width: 100%;
  height: 100%;
  object-fit: cover;
  display: block;
}

/* Mobile */

@media (max-width: 768px) {
  .hero {
    grid-template-columns: 1fr;
    gap: 30px;
    padding: 35px 0;
    min-height: auto;
  }

  .hero h1.hero-title {
    font-size: clamp(32px, 8vw, 44px);
  }

  .hero-image {
    height: 340px;
    border-radius: 140px 140px 16px 16px;
  }
}


/* FARARH Navbar */

.navbar {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: 24px;
  padding: 18px 28px;
  background: #FFFDF8;
  border: 1px solid #E3D4C2;
  border-radius: 16px;
  margin-top: 20px;
  direction: ltr;
}

.nav-logo {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 12px;
  text-decoration: none;
  color: #65300F;
  font-family: Georgia, serif;
  font-size: 22px;
  font-weight: bold;
  letter-spacing: 2px;
}

.nav-logo img {
  width: 55px;
  height: 55px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  object-fit: contain;
}

.nav-links {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: 28px;
  direction: rtl;
}

.nav-links a {
  color: #65300F;
  text-decoration: none;
  font-size: 15px;
  font-weight: 600;
  transition: color 0.2s ease;
}

.nav-links a:hover {
  color: #AE865A;
}

.nav-cart {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 8px;
  background: #65300F;
  color: #FFFDF8;
  padding: 12px 20px;
  border-radius: 25px;
  text-decoration: none;
  font-weight: 600;
  white-space: nowrap;
}

.nav-cart:hover {
  background: #84502D;
  color: #FFFDF8;
}

html {
  scroll-behavior: smooth;
}

/* Mobile Navbar */

@media (max-width: 768px) {
  .navbar {
    flex-wrap: wrap;
    gap: 14px;
    padding: 14px;
  }

  .nav-logo {
    font-size: 18px;
  }

  .nav-logo img {
    width: 45px;
    height: 45px;
  }

  .nav-links {
    order: 3;
    width: 100%;
    gap: 16px;
    padding-top: 12px;
    border-top: 1px solid #E3D4C2;
  }

  .nav-links a {
    font-size: 13px;
  }

  .nav-cart {
    padding: 10px 15px;
    font-size: 13px;
  }
}


/* FARARH Homepage Improvements */

.hero {
  min-height: 520px;
  padding-top: 45px;
  padding-bottom: 65px;
}

.hero-content {
  justify-content: center;
}

section {
  scroll-margin-top: 30px;
}


/* FARARH Store Name */

.store-name {
  font-family: Georgia, "Times New Roman", serif;
  font-size: 25px;
  font-weight: 700;
  letter-spacing: 2px;
  color: #65300F;
  text-transform: none;
}

@media (max-width: 600px) {
  .store-name {
    font-size: 18px;
    letter-spacing: 1px;
  }
}


/* FARARH Product Collection */

#products {
  padding-top: 60px;
  padding-bottom: 65px;
}

#products .sec-head {
  text-align: center;
  align-items: center;
  margin-bottom: 32px;
}

#products .sec-head h2 {
  font-family: Georgia, serif;
  color: #65300F;
  font-size: 36px;
}

#products .grid {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(3, minmax(0, 1fr));
  gap: 24px;
}

#products .card {
  background: #FFFDF8;
  border: 1px solid #E3D4C2;
  border-radius: 18px;
  overflow: hidden;
  box-shadow: 0 4px 16px rgba(101, 48, 15, 0.05);
  transition: transform 0.25s ease;
}

#products .card:hover {
  transform: translateY(-5px);
}

#products .card img {
  width: 100%;
  aspect-ratio: 1 / 1;
  object-fit: cover;
}

#products .card .body {
  padding: 18px;
  gap: 10px;
}

#products .card h3 {
  color: #65300F;
}

#products .card .price {
  color: #AE865A;
  font-size: 18px;
  font-weight: 700;
}

#products .card button {
  background: #65300F;
  color: #FFFDF8;
  border-radius: 24px;
  min-height: 44px;
}

#products .card button:hover {
  background: #84502D;
}

@media (max-width: 900px) {
  #products .grid {
    grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr));
    gap: 14px;
  }
}

@media (max-width: 480px) {
  #products .grid {
    grid-template-columns: 1fr;
  }
}


/* FARARH cart Position Fix */

.bar {
  width: min(92%, 600px);
  bottom: 16px;
  padding: 10px 15px;
}

.cart-icon {
  width: 40px;
  height: 40px;
}

.cart-checkout {
  padding: 10px 18px;
}

body {
  padding-bottom: 130px;
}

#products,
#offers,
#checkout,
#payment {
  scroll-margin-top: 30px;
}


/* FARARH Product Categories */

.category-filters {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  justify-content: center;
  gap: 12px;
  margin: 30px 0 35px;
  direction: ltr;
}

.category-btn {
  background: #FFFDF8;
  color: #65300F;
  border: 1px solid #E3D4C2;
  padding: 12px 20px;
  border-radius: 30px;
  font-size: 14px;
  font-weight: 600;
  cursor: pointer;
  transition: 0.2s ease;
}

.category-btn:hover {
  background: #EDE0CE;
}

.category-btn.active {
  background: #65300F;
  color: #FFFDF8;
  border-color: #65300F;
}

@media (max-width: 600px) {
  .category-filters {
    gap: 8px;
  }

  .category-btn {
    padding: 9px 13px;
    font-size: 12px;
  }
}


/* FARARH Footer */

.fararh-footer {
  text-align: center;
  padding: 50px 20px 125px;
  background: #FFFDF8;
  border-top: 1px solid #E3D4C2;
}

.fararh-footer h3 {
  font-family: Georgia, serif;
  font-size: 28px;
  color: #65300F;
  margin-bottom: 10px;
}

.fararh-footer p {
  color: #8B735F;
  margin-bottom: 20px;
}

.social-links {
  display: flex;
  justify-content: center;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: 15px;
  margin: 25px 0;
}

.social-links a {
  text-decoration: none;
  background: #FAF4E7;
  color: #65300F;
  border: 1px solid #E3D4C2;
  padding: 12px 24px;
  border-radius: 30px;
  transition: 0.2s;
}

.social-links a:hover {
  background: #65300F;
  color: white;
}

.copyright {
  font-size: 13px;
  margin-top: 30px;
}


/* FARARH Checkout Form */

#checkout input,
#checkout select,
#checkout textarea {
  width: 100%;
  max-width: 100%;
  box-sizing: border-box;
  background: #FAF4E7;
  color: #65300F;
  border: 1px solid #E3D4C2;
  border-radius: 12px;
  padding: 14px 16px;
  font-size: 15px;
  font-family: inherit;
}

#checkout input:focus,
#checkout select:focus,
#checkout textarea:focus {
  outline: none;
  border-color: #AE865A;
  box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(174, 134, 90, 0.12);
}

#checkout label {
  display: block;
  color: #65300F;
  font-weight: 600;
  margin-bottom: 8px;
}

#checkout input[type="file"] {
  padding: 10px;
  cursor: pointer;
}

#checkout input[type="file"]::file-selector-button {
  background: #65300F;
  color: #FFFDF8;
  border: none;
  border-radius: 8px;
  padding: 10px 16px;
  cursor: pointer;
  margin-right: 12px;
}

#checkout #submitBtn {
  background: #65300F;
  color: white;
  border: none;
  border-radius: 12px;
  padding: 16px 24px;
  font-size: 16px;
  font-weight: 600;
  cursor: pointer;
  width: 100%;
}

#checkout #submitBtn:hover {
  background: #84502D;
}

/* FARARH Payment Method */

.payment-details {
  background: #EDE0CE;
  border: 1px solid #D9C4AA;
  border-radius: 12px;
  padding: 16px;
  margin-top: 12px;
  color: #65300F;
  font-size: 14px;
  line-height: 1.8;
}

.payment-details[hidden] {
  display: none !important;
}

#method {
  cursor: pointer;
}

.payment-details {
  background: #EDE0CE;
  border: 1px solid #D9C4AA;
  border-radius: 12px;
  padding: 16px;
  margin-top: 12px;
  color: #65300F;
}

.payment-details[hidden] {
  display: none !important;
}

.payment-details p {
  margin: 10px 0;
}

.payment-number {
  font-size: 18px;
  font-weight: 700;
  direction: ltr;
  text-align: center;
  overflow-wrap: anywhere;
  padding: 12px;
  background: #FFFDF8;
  border-radius: 8px;
}

/* Custom file upload */

#checkout .hidden-file {
  position: absolute;
  width: 1px;
  height: 1px;
  opacity: 0;
  overflow: hidden;
  padding: 0;
  border: 0;
}

.upload-area {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  align-items: flex-start;
  gap: 10px;
}

#checkout .upload-btn {
  display: inline-block;
  background: #65300F;
  color: #FFFDF8;
  padding: 13px 24px;
  border-radius: 30px;
  cursor: pointer;
  margin: 0;
}

#checkout .upload-btn:hover {
  background: #84502D;
}

.hidden-file:focus-visible + .file-name {
  outline: 2px solid #AE865A;
}

.file-name {
  color: #8B735F;
  font-size: 13px;
  overflow-wrap: anywhere;
}

/* FARARH - Product Image Fix */

#products .card img {
  width: 100%;
  height: 300px;
  aspect-ratio: auto;
  object-fit: contain;
  object-position: center;
  background: #FFFDF8;
  display: block;
}

#products .card {
  overflow: hidden;
}

/* Mobile */
@media (max-width: 600px) {
  #products .card img {
    height: 230px;
  }
}

#products .grid {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(3, minmax(0, 1fr));
  gap: 22px;
}

#products .card {
  min-width: 0;
  border-radius: 18px;
}

@media (max-width: 768px) {
  #products .grid {
    grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr));
    gap: 12px;
  }
}

/* English Price Formatting */

.price,
#barTotal,
.total,
.num {
  direction: ltr !important;
  unicode-bidi: isolate;
  font-family: Arial, sans-serif;
  font-variant-numeric: lining-nums;
}
.shipping-note {
  color: #8B735F;
  font-size: 13px;
  margin-top: 8px;
  line-height: 1.6;
}

/* Offers English Text */

#offers .offer {
  direction: ltr;
  text-align: center;
}

#offers .offer b,
#offers .offer p {
  direction: ltr;
  unicode-bidi: isolate;
}


/* ===== FARARH Cart drawer / toast / Admin ===== */
.badge { background: #AE865A; color: #fff; border-radius: 99px; font-size: 12px; min-width: 20px; height: 20px; place-items: center; padding: 0 6px; }
.nav-cart { border: 0; font: inherit; font-weight: 600; }
.cart-info { cursor: pointer; }

.drawer-overlay { position: fixed; inset: 0; background: rgba(40, 20, 5, .45); z-index: 200; opacity: 0; visibility: hidden; transition: .25s; }
.drawer-overlay.show { opacity: 1; visibility: visible; }
.drawer { position: fixed; top: 0; right: 0; height: 100%; width: min(420px, 100%); background: #FFFDF8; z-index: 210; transform: translateX(100%); visibility: hidden; transition: transform .3s ease, visibility .3s; display: flex; flex-direction: column; direction: ltr; box-shadow: -8px 0 30px rgba(101, 48, 15, .15); }
.drawer.open { transform: none; visibility: visible; }
.drawer-head { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; padding: 16px 18px; border-bottom: 1px solid #E3D4C2; }
.drawer-head h3 { font-family: Georgia, serif; font-size: 22px; }
.icon-btn { background: transparent; color: #65300F; width: 38px; height: 38px; padding: 0; border-radius: 50%; font-size: 18px; }
.icon-btn:hover:not(:disabled) { background: #EDE0CE; color: #65300F; }
.drawer-body { flex: 1; overflow: auto; padding: 4px 18px; }
.drawer-foot { padding: 14px 18px 18px; border-top: 1px solid #E3D4C2; display: grid; gap: 10px; background: #FFFDF8; }
.d-empty { padding: 30px 0; text-align: center; }
.d-item { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 72px 1fr; gap: 12px; padding: 12px 0; border-bottom: 1px solid #E3D4C2; }
.d-item img { width: 72px; height: 72px; object-fit: contain; background: #fff; border-radius: 10px; border: 1px solid #E3D4C2; }
.d-item .name { font-weight: 600; }
.d-item .price { color: #AE865A; font-weight: 700; }
.d-row { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; margin-top: 6px; gap: 8px; }
.d-qty { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; }
.d-qty button { width: 32px; height: 32px; padding: 0; border-radius: 50%; }
.d-remove { background: transparent; color: #B3261E; padding: 4px 8px; font-size: 13px; }
.d-remove:hover:not(:disabled) { background: #fbe9e7; color: #B3261E; }
.drawer-foot .summary { direction: ltr; }

.toast { position: fixed; left: 50%; bottom: 105px; transform: translate(-50%, 20px); background: #65300F; color: #FFF9ED; padding: 12px 16px; border-radius: 14px; z-index: 150; display: flex; gap: 10px; align-items: center; opacity: 0; visibility: hidden; transition: .25s; width: max-content; max-width: 94%; direction: ltr; box-shadow: 0 8px 30px rgba(101, 48, 15, .25); }
.toast.show { opacity: 1; visibility: visible; transform: translate(-50%, 0); }
.toast span { font-size: 14px; }
.toast button { background: #FFF9ED; color: #65300F; padding: 6px 12px; border-radius: 20px; font-size: 13px; white-space: nowrap; }
.toast button:hover:not(:disabled) { background: #EDE0CE; color: #65300F; }
@media (max-width: 480px) { .toast { flex-wrap: wrap; justify-content: center; } }

.modal { position: fixed; inset: 0; background: rgba(40, 20, 5, .5); z-index: 300; display: none; place-items: center; padding: 16px; }
.modal.show { display: grid; }
.modal-card { background: #FFFDF8; border-radius: 16px; padding: 22px; width: min(380px, 100%); display: grid; gap: 12px; }
.modal-card h3 { font-size: 1.3rem; }
.row-btns { display: flex; gap: 8px; flex-wrap: wrap; }

.admin-panel { position: fixed; inset: 0; background: #FAF4E7; z-index: 290; overflow: auto; display: none; padding: 16px 16px 60px; }
.admin-panel.show { display: block; }
.admin-in { max-width: 900px; margin: 0 auto; display: grid; gap: 16px; }
.admin-top { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; gap: 10px; flex-wrap: wrap; }
.admin-top h2 { font-size: 1.5rem; }
.tabs { display: flex; gap: 8px; }
.tab { background: #FFFDF8; color: #65300F; border: 1px solid #E3D4C2; border-radius: 30px; }
.tab.active { background: #65300F; color: #FFFDF8; }
.panel-box { background: #FFFDF8; border: 1px solid #E3D4C2; border-radius: 16px; padding: 16px; display: grid; gap: 12px; }
.panel-box h3 { font-size: 1.15rem; }
.a-prod { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 70px 1fr auto; gap: 12px; align-items: center; padding: 10px 0; border-bottom: 1px solid #E3D4C2; }
.a-prod img { width: 70px; height: 70px; object-fit: contain; background: #fff; border-radius: 10px; border: 1px solid #E3D4C2; }
.a-order { border: 1px solid #E3D4C2; border-radius: 12px; padding: 12px; display: grid; gap: 6px; background: #FAF4E7; }
.a-order img { max-width: min(260px, 100%); border-radius: 10px; border: 1px solid #E3D4C2; }
button.danger { color: #B3261E; border-color: #B3261E; }
button.danger:hover:not(:disabled) { background: #B3261E; color: #fff; }
.ok-text { color: #1F7A4D; font-weight: 600; }
.admin-panel .preview { display: none; }

[hidden] { display: none !important; }

/* ===== Responsive fixes (laptop + phone) ===== */
html, body { overflow-x: hidden; }
img { max-width: 100%; }
.wrap { width: 100%; }

.navbar { position: sticky; top: 10px; z-index: 120; box-shadow: 0 6px 24px rgba(101, 48, 15, .08); }
.nav-logo img { width: 84px; height: 84px; }
.nav-logo { gap: 14px; }

.hero { grid-template-columns: 1.05fr .95fr; padding: 40px 0 30px; gap: 48px; }
.hero-logo { width: 150px; height: 150px; border-radius: 50%; align-self: flex-start; box-shadow: 0 10px 30px rgba(101, 48, 15, .15); }
.hero-image { height: clamp(340px, 42vw, 480px); }

#products .grid { grid-template-columns: repeat(3, minmax(0, 1fr)); }
@media (min-width: 1100px) { .wrap { max-width: 1160px; } #products .grid { grid-template-columns: repeat(4, minmax(0, 1fr)); } }
#products .card img { height: auto; aspect-ratio: 4 / 5; object-fit: cover; background: #EDE0CE; }
#products .card .body { padding: 14px; }
#products .card h3 { font-size: 1rem; line-height: 1.35; }

@media (max-width: 900px) {
  #products .grid { grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr)); gap: 12px; }
}
@media (max-width: 768px) {
  .navbar { top: 6px; margin-top: 10px; }
  .nav-logo img { width: 62px; height: 62px; }
  .hero { grid-template-columns: 1fr; gap: 22px; padding: 22px 0 10px; min-height: 0; }
  .hero-logo { width: 112px; height: 112px; }
  .hero-image { height: clamp(260px, 70vw, 380px); border-radius: 120px 120px 16px 16px; order: -1; }
  .hero-content { align-items: center; text-align: center; }
  .hero-logo { align-self: center; }
  .hero h1.hero-title, .hero p.hero-subtitle { text-align: center; }
  .hero .cta { align-self: center; }
  #products { padding-top: 30px; padding-bottom: 30px; }
  #products .sec-head h2 { font-size: 28px; }
  .category-filters { flex-wrap: nowrap; justify-content: flex-start; overflow-x: auto; margin: 20px -16px 24px; padding: 4px 16px; scrollbar-width: none; }
  .category-filters::-webkit-scrollbar { display: none; }
  .category-btn { flex: 0 0 auto; }
}
@media (max-width: 480px) {
  body { padding-left: 12px; padding-right: 12px; }
  #products .grid { grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr)); gap: 10px; }
  #products .card { border-radius: 14px; }
  #products .card .body { padding: 10px; gap: 6px; }
  #products .card h3 { font-size: .88rem; }
  #products .card .price { font-size: 15px; }
  #products .card button { min-height: 40px; font-size: 13px; padding: 8px 10px; }
  .qty button { width: 34px; height: 34px; }
  .order { padding: 14px; }
  .offers { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
  .a-prod { grid-template-columns: 60px 1fr; }
  .a-prod img { width: 60px; height: 60px; }
  .a-prod .row-btns { grid-column: 1 / -1; }
}

/* ===== Animations ===== */
@keyframes fadeUp { from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(22px); } to { opacity: 1; transform: none; } }
@keyframes fadeDown { from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(-16px); } to { opacity: 1; transform: none; } }
@keyframes zoomIn { from { opacity: 0; transform: scale(.94); } to { opacity: 1; transform: none; } }
@keyframes floaty { 0%, 100% { transform: translateY(0); } 50% { transform: translateY(-7px); } }
@keyframes bump { 0% { transform: translateX(-50%) scale(1); } 40% { transform: translateX(-50%) scale(1.045); } 100% { transform: translateX(-50%) scale(1); } }
@keyframes badgePop { 0% { transform: scale(.4); } 60% { transform: scale(1.35); } 100% { transform: scale(1); } }
@keyframes shine { to { background-position: -200% 0; } }

@media (prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference) {
  .navbar { animation: fadeDown .6s ease both; }
  .hero-logo { animation: zoomIn .8s .1s ease both, floaty 5s 1s ease-in-out infinite; }
  .hero-label { animation: fadeUp .7s .2s ease both; }
  .hero h1.hero-title { animation: fadeUp .7s .3s ease both; }
  .hero p.hero-subtitle { animation: fadeUp .7s .4s ease both; }
  .hero .cta { animation: fadeUp .7s .5s ease both; }
  .hero-image { animation: zoomIn 1s .25s ease both; }
  .hero-image img { transition: transform 1.2s ease; }
  .hero-image:hover img { transform: scale(1.05); }

  .js .rv { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(26px); transition: opacity .7s ease, transform .7s ease; }
  .js .rv.in { opacity: 1; transform: none; }

  #products .card.reveal { animation: fadeUp .55s ease both; animation-delay: calc(var(--i, 0) * 70ms); }
  #products .card img { transition: transform .5s ease; }
  #products .card:hover img { transform: scale(1.06); }
  #products .card { transition: transform .25s ease, box-shadow .25s ease; }
  #products .card:hover { box-shadow: 0 14px 30px rgba(101, 48, 15, .14); }
  #products .card { overflow: hidden; }

  button, .btn, .cart-checkout, .nav-cart { transition: background .25s, color .25s, transform .15s, box-shadow .25s; }
  button:active:not(:disabled), .btn:active, .cart-checkout:active { transform: scale(.96); }
  .hero .cta:hover, .cart-checkout:hover, .nav-cart:hover { transform: translateY(-2px); box-shadow: 0 8px 18px rgba(101, 48, 15, .22); }
  .hero .cta::after { content: ""; }
  .offer { transition: transform .25s, box-shadow .25s; }
  .offer:hover { transform: translateY(-4px); box-shadow: 0 10px 22px rgba(101, 48, 15, .12); }
  .nav-links a { position: relative; }
  .nav-links a::after { content: ""; position: absolute; left: 0; right: 0; bottom: -4px; height: 2px; background: #AE865A; transform: scaleX(0); transition: transform .25s; }
  .nav-links a:hover::after { transform: scaleX(1); }
  .bar.bump { animation: bump .35s ease; }
  .badge.pop { animation: badgePop .35s ease; }
  .d-item { animation: fadeUp .35s ease both; }
  .modal.show .modal-card { animation: zoomIn .25s ease both; }
}


/* ===== Checkout as a separate page ===== */
body:not(.view-checkout) #checkout { display: none; }
.view-checkout header.hero, .view-checkout #offers, .view-checkout #products { display: none; }
.view-checkout .bar, .view-checkout .toast { display: none; }
.view-checkout body, body.view-checkout { padding-bottom: 40px; }
.view-checkout .fararh-footer { padding-bottom: 40px; margin-top: 30px; }
.co-head { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; gap: 10px; flex-wrap: wrap; margin-bottom: 14px; direction: ltr; }
.view-checkout #checkout { padding-top: 24px; max-width: 760px; margin-inline: auto; }
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference) { .view-checkout #checkout { animation: fadeUp .5s ease both; } }

.modal.sheet { z-index: 180; align-items: end; }
.modal.sheet .modal-card { width: min(440px, 100%); box-shadow: 0 -10px 40px rgba(101, 48, 15, .25); }
.added-top { display: flex; gap: 12px; align-items: center; }
.added-top img { width: 64px; height: 64px; object-fit: cover; border-radius: 12px; border: 1px solid #E3D4C2; background: #fff; }
.added-top b { color: #1F7A4D; font-size: 1.05rem; }
@media (min-width: 700px) { .modal.sheet { align-items: center; } }
.hero{grid-template-columns:1fr !important}
</style>
</head>

<div class="wrap">

</header>



  <section id="offers" class="rv">

<div class="category-filters" id="categoryFilters">

</div>

    <div class="grid" id="grid"></div>
  </section>

  

  <section id="checkout" class="rv">

      <button type="button" class="ghost" id="editCart">Edit cart 🛍</button>
    </div>
    <div class="sec-head"><h2>Data of order </h2></div>

    <form class="order" id="orderForm" novalidate>
      <p hidden><label>Leave empty: <input name="bot-field" tabindex="-1" autocomplete="off"></label></p>

      <div>
        <h3 style="font-size:1.1rem;margin-bottom:8px">Your Order</h3>

      <div class="field">

        <div class="field"><label for="gov">Governorate</label>
          
<select id="gov" name="gov" required>

        <div class="field"><label for="address">address</label><textarea id="address" name="address" autocomplete="street-address" placeholder="الشارع، رقم العمارة، الدور، علامة مميزة"></textarea><div class="err" data-for="address"></div></div>

<select id="method" name="pay_method" required>

</select>

<footer class="fararh-footer rv">

  </div>

      <input id="promo" type="text" placeholder="Promo code" autocomplete="off">
      <button type="button" class="ghost" id="applyPromo">Apply</button>
    </div>
    <div class="err" id="promoMsg"></div>

    <button type="button" class="ghost" id="drawerContinue">Continue shopping</button>
  </div>
</aside>
<div class="toast" id="toast" role="status" aria-live="polite"></div>
<div class="modal sheet" id="addedModal">
  <div class="modal-card added" dir="ltr">
    <div class="added-top">
      <img id="addedImg" alt="">
      <div><b>✓ Added to cart</b><div class="note" id="addedName"></div></div>
    </div>
    <button type="button" id="addedCart">Go to cart</button>
    <button type="button" class="ghost" id="addedContinue">Continue shopping</button>
  </div>
</div>

<!-- ===== Admin login ===== -->
<div class="modal" id="loginModal">
  <div class="modal-card" dir="rtl">
    <h3>دخول الأدمن</h3>
    <input type="password" id="adminPw" placeholder="كلمة السر" autocomplete="current-password">
    <div class="err" id="loginErr"></div>
    <div class="row-btns">
      <button type="button" id="loginBtn">دخول</button>
      <button type="button" class="ghost" id="loginCancel">إلغاء</button>
    </div>
  </div>
</div>

<!-- ===== Admin panel ===== -->
<div class="admin-panel" id="adminPanel" dir="rtl">
  <div class="admin-in">
    <div class="admin-top">
      <h2>لوحة التحكم</h2>
      <div class="row-btns">
        <button type="button" class="ghost" id="adminClose">رجوع للموقع</button>
        <button type="button" class="ghost danger" id="adminLogout">تسجيل خروج</button>
      </div>
    </div>
    <div class="tabs">
      <button type="button" class="tab active" data-tab="prod">المنتجات</button>
      <button type="button" class="tab" data-tab="ord">الطلبات</button>
      <button type="button" class="tab" data-tab="set">الإعدادات</button>
    </div>

    <div id="tabProd" class="admin-in">
      <div class="panel-box" id="pFormBox">
        <h3 id="pFormTitle">إضافة منتج جديد</h3>
        <div class="cols">
          <div class="field"><label for="pName">اسم المنتج</label><input id="pName" type="text" dir="ltr" style="text-align:right"></div>
          <div class="field"><label for="pKind">القسم</label><select id="pKind"></select></div>
          <div class="field"><label for="pPrice">السعر (EGP)</label><input id="pPrice" type="number" min="1" inputmode="numeric" dir="ltr" style="text-align:right"></div>
          <div class="field"><label for="pOld">السعر قبل الخصم (اختياري)</label><input id="pOld" type="number" min="0" inputmode="numeric" dir="ltr" style="text-align:right"></div>
        </div>
        <div class="field">
          <label for="pImage">صورة المنتج</label>
          <input id="pImage" type="file" accept="image/*">
          <img id="pPreview" class="preview" alt="" style="max-width:160px">
        </div>
        <div class="err" id="pMsg"></div>
        <div class="row-btns">
          <button type="button" id="pSave">حفظ المنتج</button>
          <button type="button" class="ghost" id="pCancel" hidden>إلغاء التعديل</button>
        </div>
      </div>
      <div class="panel-box">
        <h3>المنتجات الحالية</h3>
        <div id="aProdList"></div>
      </div>
    </div>

    <div id="tabSet" class="admin-in" hidden>
      <div class="panel-box">
        <h3>تغيير كلمة السر</h3>
        <div class="field"><label for="pwNew">كلمة السر الجديدة (6 على الأقل)</label><input id="pwNew" type="password" autocomplete="new-password"></div>
        <div class="field"><label for="pwNew2">اكتبها تاني للتأكيد</label><input id="pwNew2" type="password" autocomplete="new-password"></div>
        <div class="err" id="pwMsg"></div>
        <div class="row-btns"><button type="button" id="pwSave">تغيير كلمة السر</button></div>
      </div>
    </div>

    <div id="tabOrd" class="admin-in" hidden>
      <div class="panel-box">
        <div class="row-btns">
          <button type="button" id="ordXlsx">⬇ تحميل Excel (.xlsx)</button>
          <button type="button" class="ghost" id="ordSheet">فتح الشيت في Google</button>
          <button type="button" class="ghost" id="ordRefresh">تحديث</button>
        </div>
        <div id="aOrdList"></div>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>
</div>


<script>
/* =====================================================================
   ★ الإعدادات (أول الملف) ★
   ===================================================================== */

const BRAND = "FARARH ACCESSORIES";
const CURRENCY = "EGP";
const DEPOSIT_PCT = 100;
const WHATSAPP = "";                                   // اختياري: رقم واتساب دولي بدون + (بيظهر لو الأوردر فشل)
const API_URL = "https://script.google.com/macros/s/AKfycbx-81eKIv8Lpv0DG291F9F2WvRx5y7-WQm-6nSN2hwwNpDFe_Ab3048fOOKg6FQLLk/exec";     // ← رابط Web App بتاع Apps Script
const SHIPPING_FEE = 60;                               // الشحن: 60 جنيه لكل المحافظات
const PROMOS = { "RAN2005": 15 };                      // أكواد الخصم: الكود → النسبة %
const CATEGORIES = [
  ["necklace", "Necklaces"], ["ring", "Rings"], ["earring", "Earrings"], ["bracelet", "Bracelets"],
  ["handchain", "Hand Chains"], ["bangle", "Bangles"], ["anklet", "Anklets"]
];

const DEFAULT_PRODUCTS = [];   // فاضية: كل المنتجات بتتضاف من لوحة الأدمن وبتتخزن في Drive

const PAY_METHODS = [
  {
    name: "InstaPay",
    num: "YOUR_INSTAPAY_ADDRESS",
    hint: "Transfer using InstaPay"
  }
];


// العروض
const AUTO_OFFER = { minQty: 3, pct: 10 };                 // خصم تلقائي: لو الطلب 3 قطع أو أكتر = 10%
const OFFERS = [                                           // الكروت اللي بتظهر في قسم العروض
  { tag: "automatic",   title: " 10% discount ",   text: "order 2 products and get 10 % discount on the thired product" },
  { tag: "limited",    title: " 15% discount for a limited time ",  text: "use Ran2005 Code to get discount" }
];

/* =====================================================================
   من هنا لتحت كود الموقع
   ===================================================================== */

const $ = (id) => document.getElementById(id);
const fmt = (n) => Number(n).toLocaleString("en-US", { minimumFractionDigits: 0, maximumFractionDigits: 2 }) + " EGP";
function el(tag, attrs, text) {
  const e = document.createElement(tag);
  if (attrs) for (const k in attrs) e.setAttribute(k, attrs[k]);
  if (text != null) e.textContent = text;
  return e;
}

function placeholderImg(p) {
  const h = p.hue || 300, c1 = `hsl(${h} 45% 88%)`, c2 = `hsl(${h} 40% 72%)`, st = `hsl(${h} 45% 28%)`;
  let shape = "";
  if (p.kind === "ring") shape = `<ellipse cx="200" cy="230" rx="70" ry="80" fill="none" stroke="${st}" stroke-width="16"/><polygon points="200,110 230,150 200,185 170,150" fill="${st}"/>`;
  else if (p.kind === "earring") shape = `<g fill="none" stroke="${st}" stroke-width="10"><circle cx="150" cy="160" r="12"/><circle cx="250" cy="160" r="12"/></g><path d="M150 172 C120 230 120 290 150 300 C180 290 180 230 150 172Z" fill="${st}"/><path d="M250 172 C220 230 220 290 250 300 C280 290 280 230 250 172Z" fill="${st}"/>`;
  else if (p.kind === "necklace") shape = `<path d="M90 110 C100 280 300 280 310 110" fill="none" stroke="${st}" stroke-width="8"/><path d="M200 262 C175 240 160 262 200 296 C240 262 225 240 200 262Z" fill="${st}"/>`;
  else shape = `<ellipse cx="200" cy="200" rx="110" ry="60" fill="none" stroke="${st}" stroke-width="18"/><circle cx="200" cy="140" r="10" fill="${st}"/>`;
  const svg = `<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 400 400"><defs><linearGradient id="g" x1="0" y1="0" x2="1" y2="1"><stop offset="0" stop-color="${c1}"/><stop offset="1" stop-color="${c2}"/></linearGradient></defs><rect width="400" height="400" fill="url(#g)"/>${shape}</svg>`;
  return "data:image/svg+xml;charset=utf-8," + encodeURIComponent(svg);
}

/* ---------- Backend (Google Apps Script) ---------- */

const apiReady = () => /^https:\/\/script\.google\.com\//.test(API_URL);

async function api(payload) {
  // text/plain عشان نتجنب preflight مع Apps Script
  const res = await fetch(API_URL, { method: "POST", headers: { "Content-Type": "text/plain;charset=utf-8" }, body: JSON.stringify(payload) });
  const data = await res.json();
  if (!data.ok) throw new Error(data.error || "Request failed");
  return data;
}

function fileToJpeg(file, maxDim, quality) {
  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    const url = URL.createObjectURL(file);
    const img = new Image();
    img.onload = () => {
      let w = img.naturalWidth, h = img.naturalHeight;
      const k = Math.min(1, maxDim / Math.max(w, h));
      w = Math.round(w * k); h = Math.round(h * k);
      const cv = document.createElement("canvas");
      cv.width = w; cv.height = h;
      const ctx = cv.getContext("2d");
      ctx.fillStyle = "#fff"; ctx.fillRect(0, 0, w, h);
      ctx.drawImage(img, 0, 0, w, h);
      URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
      resolve({ data: cv.toDataURL("image/jpeg", quality).split(",")[1], mime: "image/jpeg", w, h });
    };
    img.onerror = () => { URL.revokeObjectURL(url); reject(new Error("Cannot read this image")); };
    img.src = url;
  });
}

/* ---------- State ---------- */

let PRODUCTS = apiReady() ? [] : DEFAULT_PRODUCTS.slice();
let productsLoading = apiReady();
let serverHasProducts = false;
let selectedCategory = "all";
let animateGrid = true;
let promoPct = 0, promoCode = "";
const cart = {};
try { Object.assign(cart, JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem("fararh_cart") || "{}")); } catch (e) {}
function saveCart() { try { localStorage.setItem("fararh_cart", JSON.stringify(cart)); } catch (e) {} }

function lines() {
  return PRODUCTS.filter((p) => cart[p.id] > 0).map((p) => ({ id: p.id, name: p.name, price: p.price, img: p.img, kind: p.kind, qty: cart[p.id] }));
}

function calc() {
  const ls = lines();
  const qty = ls.reduce((s, l) => s + l.qty, 0);
  const subtotal = ls.reduce((s, l) => s + l.qty * l.price, 0);
  const autoPct = qty >= AUTO_OFFER.minQty ? AUTO_OFFER.pct : 0;
  const pct = Math.max(autoPct, promoPct);
  const discount = Math.round(subtotal * pct / 100);
  const shipping = qty > 0 ? SHIPPING_FEE : 0;
  const total = subtotal - discount + shipping;
  const deposit = total;
  return { ls, qty, subtotal, pct, discount, shipping, total, deposit };
}

async function loadProducts() {
  try {
    const cached = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem("fararh_products") || "null");
    if (apiReady() && Array.isArray(cached) && cached.length && productsLoading) { PRODUCTS = cached; productsLoading = false; update(); }
  } catch (e) {}
  if (!apiReady()) return;
  try {
    const r = await fetch(API_URL + "?action=products&t=" + Date.now());
    const d = await r.json();
    if (!d.ok) throw new Error(d.error || "bad response");
    serverHasProducts = d.products.length > 0;
    if (serverHasProducts) {
      PRODUCTS = d.products;
      try { localStorage.setItem("fararh_products", JSON.stringify(PRODUCTS)); } catch (e) {}
    } else {
      PRODUCTS = DEFAULT_PRODUCTS.slice();
      try { localStorage.removeItem("fararh_products"); } catch (e) {}
    }
  } catch (e) {
    if (productsLoading) PRODUCTS = DEFAULT_PRODUCTS.slice();
    console.warn("Could not load products:", e);
  }
  productsLoading = false;
  animateGrid = true;
  update();
}

/* ---------- Render: static ---------- */

function renderStatic() {
  const bf = $("brandFoot"); if (bf) bf.textContent = BRAND;
  OFFERS.forEach((o) => {
    const d = el("div", { class: "offer" });
    d.append(el("span", { class: "tag" }, o.tag), el("b", null, o.title), el("p", null, o.text));
    $("offersBox").append(d);
  });
  const ms = $("method");
  if (ms) {
    ms.innerHTML = "";
    ms.append(el("option", { value: "" }, "Choose payment method"));
    PAY_METHODS.forEach((m) => ms.append(el("option", { value: m.name }, m.name)));
    initMethod();
  }
}

function initMethod() {
  const ms = $("method");
  if (PAY_METHODS.length === 1) {
    const first = ms.querySelector('option[value=""]');
    if (first) first.remove();
    ms.value = PAY_METHODS[0].name;
    ms.dispatchEvent(new Event("change"));
  }
}

/* ---------- Render: products ---------- */

function addToCart(p) {
  cart[p.id] = 1;
  try { showAdded(p); } catch (e) { console.warn(e); }   // البوب أب الأول، قبل أي تحديث تاني
  try { update(); } catch (e) { console.warn(e); }
  try { saveCart(); } catch (e) {}
  setTimeout(() => {   // لو النافذة ماظهرتش لأي سبب، نظهر شريط بديل
    try { if (getComputedStyle($("addedModal")).display === "none") showToast("✓ Added to cart"); } catch (e) {}
  }, 150);
}

function renderGrid() {
  const g = $("grid");
  g.textContent = "";
  if (productsLoading) { const n = el("p", { class: "note" }, "Loading products…"); n.style.gridColumn = "1 / -1"; g.append(n); return; }
  const list = PRODUCTS.filter((p) => selectedCategory === "all" || p.kind === selectedCategory);
  if (!list.length) { const n = el("p", { class: "note" }, "No products here yet."); n.style.gridColumn = "1 / -1"; n.style.textAlign = "center"; g.append(n); return; }
  const anim = animateGrid; animateGrid = false;
  list.forEach((p, idx) => {
    const card = el("div", { class: "card" + (anim ? " reveal" : "") });
    card.style.setProperty("--i", String(Math.min(idx, 8)));
    const img = el("img", { alt: p.name, loading: "lazy", width: "400", height: "400" });
    img.onerror = () => { img.onerror = null; img.src = placeholderImg(p); };
    img.src = p.img || placeholderImg(p);
    const body = el("div", { class: "body" });
    const price = el("div", { class: "price" }, fmt(p.price));
    if (p.old) price.append(el("span", { class: "old" }, fmt(p.old)));
    const actions = el("div", { class: "actions" });
    const q = cart[p.id] || 0;
    if (q === 0) {
      const add = el("button", { type: "button" }, "Add to Cart");
      add.addEventListener("click", () => addToCart(p));
      actions.append(add);
    } else {
      const wrap = el("div", { class: "qty" });
      const minus = el("button", { type: "button", "aria-label": "less" }, "-");
      const plus = el("button", { type: "button", "aria-label": "more" }, "+");
      minus.addEventListener("click", () => { cart[p.id] = Math.max(0, (cart[p.id] || 0) - 1); update(); });
      plus.addEventListener("click", () => { cart[p.id] = Math.min(20, (cart[p.id] || 0) + 1); update(); });
      wrap.append(minus, el("span", null, String(q)), plus);
      actions.append(wrap);
    }
    body.append(el("h3", null, p.name), price, actions);
    card.append(img, body);
    g.append(card);
  });
}

/* ---------- Render: order summary / bar / drawer ---------- */

function summaryRows(target, c) {
  target.textContent = "";
  const row = (a, b, cls) => { const r = el("div", { class: "row" + (cls ? " " + cls : "") }); r.append(el("span", null, a), el("span", null, b)); target.append(r); };
  row("Products", fmt(c.subtotal));
  if (c.discount > 0) row("Offer (" + c.pct + "%)", "− " + fmt(c.discount));
  row("Shipping", c.qty > 0 ? fmt(c.shipping) : "—");
  row("Total", fmt(c.total), "total");
  return row;
}

function renderOrder() {
  const c = calc();
  const il = $("itemsList");
  il.textContent = "";
  if (c.qty === 0) {
    il.append(el("p", { class: "note" }, "Choose products"));
  } else {
    c.ls.forEach((l) => {
      const r = el("div", { class: "row" });
      r.append(el("span", null, l.name + " × " + l.qty), el("span", null, fmt(l.qty * l.price)));
      il.append(r);
    });
  }
  const row = summaryRows($("summary"), c);
  row("Full Payment (100%)", fmt(c.total), "dep");
}

let lastQty = 0;
function renderBar() {
  const c = calc();
  if (c.qty > lastQty) {
    const bar = document.querySelector(".bar"), bd = $("navBadge");
    bar.classList.remove("bump"); bd.classList.remove("pop"); void bar.offsetWidth;
    bar.classList.add("bump"); bd.classList.add("pop");
  }
  lastQty = c.qty;
  $("barCount").textContent = c.qty ? c.qty + (c.qty === 1 ? " item" : " items") : "Cart is empty";
  $("barTotal").textContent = c.qty ? "Total " + fmt(c.total) : "Choose products to order";
  const b = $("navBadge");
  b.textContent = String(c.qty);
  b.style.display = c.qty ? "inline-grid" : "none";
}

function renderDrawer() {
  const c = calc();
  const box = $("drawerItems");
  box.textContent = "";
  if (!c.qty) {
    box.append(el("p", { class: "note d-empty" }, "Your cart is empty. Add something you like ✨"));
  } else {
    c.ls.forEach((l) => {
      const item = el("div", { class: "d-item" });
      const img = el("img", { alt: l.name });
      img.onerror = () => { img.onerror = null; img.src = placeholderImg(l); };
      img.src = l.img || placeholderImg(l);
      const info = el("div");
      const row = el("div", { class: "d-row" });
      const qty = el("div", { class: "d-qty" });
      const minus = el("button", { type: "button", "aria-label": "less" }, "−");
      const plus = el("button", { type: "button", "aria-label": "more" }, "+");
      minus.addEventListener("click", () => { cart[l.id] = Math.max(0, (cart[l.id] || 0) - 1); update(); });
      plus.addEventListener("click", () => { cart[l.id] = Math.min(20, (cart[l.id] || 0) + 1); update(); });
      qty.append(minus, el("span", null, String(l.qty)), plus);
      const rm = el("button", { type: "button", class: "d-remove" }, "Remove");
      rm.addEventListener("click", () => { cart[l.id] = 0; update(); });
      row.append(qty, rm);
      info.append(el("div", { class: "name" }, l.name), el("div", { class: "price" }, fmt(l.price * l.qty)), row);
      item.append(img, info);
      box.append(item);
    });
  }
  summaryRows($("drawerSummary"), c);
  $("drawerCheckout").disabled = c.qty === 0;
}

function update() {
  renderBar();
  renderGrid();
  renderOrder();
  renderDrawer();
  saveCart();
}

/* ---------- Drawer / toast ---------- */

function openDrawer() {
  $("drawerOverlay").classList.add("show");
  $("cartDrawer").classList.add("open");
  $("cartDrawer").setAttribute("aria-hidden", "false");
  document.body.style.overflow = "hidden";
}
function closeDrawer() {
  $("drawerOverlay").classList.remove("show");
  $("cartDrawer").classList.remove("open");
  $("cartDrawer").setAttribute("aria-hidden", "true");
  document.body.style.overflow = "";
}
function goCheckout() { showCheckout(); }
const inCheckout = () => document.body.classList.contains("view-checkout");
function showCheckout(push = true) {
  closeDrawer();
  hideAdded();
  $("toast").classList.remove("show");
  if (calc().qty === 0) { openDrawer(); return; }
  document.body.classList.add("view-checkout");
  $("checkout").classList.add("in");
  if (push && location.hash !== "#checkout") { try { history.pushState({ v: "co" }, "", "#checkout"); } catch (e) {} }
  window.scrollTo(0, 0);
}
function showShop(targetId, push = true) {
  const was = inCheckout();
  document.body.classList.remove("view-checkout");
  if (was && push && location.hash === "#checkout") { try { history.pushState({ v: "shop" }, "", "#" + (targetId || "home")); } catch (e) {} }
  const t = targetId && $(targetId);
  requestAnimationFrame(() => { if (t) t.scrollIntoView(); else window.scrollTo(0, 0); });
}
window.addEventListener("popstate", () => {
  if (location.hash === "#checkout" && calc().qty > 0) showCheckout(false);
  else if (inCheckout()) showShop(null, false);
});
document.querySelectorAll('a[href^="#"]').forEach((a) => a.addEventListener("click", (e) => {
  const id = a.getAttribute("href").slice(1);
  if (id === "checkout") { e.preventDefault(); showCheckout(); }
  else if (inCheckout()) { e.preventDefault(); showShop(id); }
}));
$("backShop").addEventListener("click", () => showShop("products"));
$("editCart").addEventListener("click", openDrawer);
if (location.hash === "#checkout") { try { history.replaceState(null, "", "#home"); } catch (e) {} }

let toastTimer;
function showAdded(p) {
  $("addedModal").classList.add("show");
  try {
    $("addedName").textContent = p.name;
    const im = $("addedImg");
    im.onerror = () => { im.onerror = null; im.src = placeholderImg(p); };
    im.src = p.img || placeholderImg(p);
  } catch (e) { console.warn(e); }
}
const hideAdded = () => $("addedModal").classList.remove("show");
$("addedContinue").addEventListener("click", hideAdded);
$("addedCart").addEventListener("click", () => { hideAdded(); openDrawer(); });
$("addedModal").addEventListener("click", (e) => { if (e.target === e.currentTarget) hideAdded(); });

function showToast(msg) {
  const t = $("toast");
  t.textContent = "";
  const v = el("button", { type: "button" }, "View cart");
  const k = el("button", { type: "button" }, "Checkout");
  v.addEventListener("click", () => { t.classList.remove("show"); openDrawer(); });
  k.addEventListener("click", goCheckout);
  t.append(el("span", null, msg), v, k);
  t.classList.add("show");
  clearTimeout(toastTimer);
  toastTimer = setTimeout(() => t.classList.remove("show"), 4500);
}

$("navCart").addEventListener("click", openDrawer);
$("barOpen").addEventListener("click", openDrawer);
$("drawerClose").addEventListener("click", closeDrawer);
$("drawerOverlay").addEventListener("click", closeDrawer);
$("drawerContinue").addEventListener("click", closeDrawer);
$("drawerCheckout").addEventListener("click", goCheckout);

/* ---------- Promo ---------- */

$("applyPromo").addEventListener("click", () => {
  const v = $("promo").value.trim().toUpperCase();
  const m = $("promoMsg");
  if (!v) { promoPct = 0; promoCode = ""; m.textContent = ""; }
  else if (PROMOS[v]) { promoPct = PROMOS[v]; promoCode = v; m.style.color = "var(--ok)"; m.textContent = "Discount applied: " + promoPct + "%"; }
  else { promoPct = 0; promoCode = ""; m.style.color = "var(--bad)"; m.textContent = "Invalid code"; }
  update();
});

/* ---------- Category filters ---------- */

document.querySelectorAll(".category-btn").forEach((button) => {
  button.addEventListener("click", () => {
    selectedCategory = button.dataset.category;
    document.querySelectorAll(".category-btn").forEach((b) => b.classList.remove("active"));
    button.classList.add("active");
    animateGrid = true;
    renderGrid();
  });
});

/* ---------- Payment details ---------- */

$("method").addEventListener("change", function () {
  const selected = PAY_METHODS.find((m) => m.name === this.value);
  const details = $("paymentDetails");
  if (!selected) { details.hidden = true; return; }
  $("paymentTitle").textContent = selected.name;
  $("paymentNumber").textContent = selected.num;
  details.hidden = false;
});

/* ---------- Receipt preview ---------- */

$("receipt").addEventListener("change", () => {
  const f = $("receipt").files[0];
  $("fileName").textContent = f ? f.name : "";
  const pv = $("preview");
  if (pv.dataset.url) { URL.revokeObjectURL(pv.dataset.url); pv.dataset.url = ""; }
  if (f && f.type.startsWith("image/")) {
    const u = URL.createObjectURL(f);
    pv.src = u; pv.dataset.url = u; pv.style.display = "block";
  } else { pv.style.display = "none"; }
});

/* ---------- Validate + submit order ---------- */

function setErr(k, t) { const e = document.querySelector('[data-for="' + k + '"]'); if (e) e.textContent = t || ""; }

function validate() {
  let ok = true;
  const c = calc();
  ["name", "phone", "gov", "address", "method", "receipt"].forEach((k) => setErr(k, ""));
  if (c.qty === 0) { showResult("bad", "Choose at least one product to order"); return false; }
  if (!$("name").value.trim()) { setErr("name", "Write your name"); ok = false; }
  const ph = $("phone").value.replace(/[\s-]/g, "").replace(/[٠-٩]/g, (d) => "٠١٢٣٤٥٦٧٨٩".indexOf(d));
  if (!/^(\+?20|0)?1[0125]\d{8}$/.test(ph)) { setErr("phone", "Write a correct phone number"); ok = false; }
  if (!$("gov").value) { setErr("gov", "Choose governorate"); ok = false; }
  if ($("address").value.trim().length < 10) { setErr("address", "Write your address"); ok = false; }
  if (!$("method").value) { setErr("method", "Choose payment method"); ok = false; }
  const f = $("receipt").files[0];
  if (!f) { setErr("receipt", "Upload the transfer photo"); ok = false; }
  else if (!f.type.startsWith("image/")) { setErr("receipt", "It must be a photo"); ok = false; }
  else if (f.size > 15 * 1024 * 1024) { setErr("receipt", "The image is too large (max 15 MB)"); ok = false; }
  return ok;
}

function showResult(kind, text, summary) {
  const r = $("result");
  r.hidden = false;
  r.className = "msg " + kind;
  r.textContent = text;
  if (summary) {
    r.append(el("pre", { class: "fallback" }, summary));
    const cp = el("button", { type: "button", class: "ghost" }, "Copy order summary");
    cp.addEventListener("click", async () => {
      try { await navigator.clipboard.writeText(summary); cp.textContent = "Copied"; } catch (e) { cp.textContent = "Select the text and copy it"; }
    });
    r.append(cp);
    if (WHATSAPP) {
      r.append(el("a", { class: "btn", href: "https://wa.me/" + WHATSAPP + "?text=" + encodeURIComponent(summary), target: "_blank", rel: "noopener" }, "Send order on WhatsApp"));
    }
  }
  r.scrollIntoView({ block: "nearest", behavior: "smooth" });
}

$("orderForm").addEventListener("submit", async (ev) => {
  ev.preventDefault();
  if (!validate()) return;
  const form = $("orderForm");
  const btn = $("submitBtn");
  const c = calc();
  const id = "ORD-" + Date.now().toString(36).toUpperCase();
  const itemsText = c.ls.map((l) => l.name + " × " + l.qty).join(" | ");
  const info = {
    id, name: $("name").value.trim(), phone: $("phone").value.trim(), gov: $("gov").value,
    address: $("address").value.trim(), method: $("method").value, txref: $("txref").value.trim(),
    itemsText, items: c.ls.map((l) => ({ name: l.name, qty: l.qty, price: l.price })), subtotal: c.subtotal, shipping: c.shipping, discount: c.discount, pct: c.pct, promo: promoCode, total: c.total
  };

  btn.disabled = true; btn.textContent = "Sending your order…";
  try {
    if (!apiReady()) throw new Error("API_URL is not set");
    const f = $("receipt").files[0];
    let receipt, thumb;
    try {
      [receipt, thumb] = await Promise.all([fileToJpeg(f, 1600, 0.8), fileToJpeg(f, 900, 0.7)]);
      if (!receipt || receipt.data.length < 5000 || receipt.w < 150 || receipt.h < 150) throw new Error("tiny");
    } catch (imgErr) {
      setErr("receipt", "This image can't be used. Choose a clear photo/screenshot of the transfer.");
      $("receipt").scrollIntoView({ behavior: "smooth", block: "center" });
      btn.disabled = false; btn.textContent = "Confirm";
      return;                                  // مفيش أوردر من غير صورة سليمة
    }
    await api({ action: "order", botField: form.elements["bot-field"].value, order: info, receipt, thumb });
    showResult("ok", "Your order has been received (" + id + "). We will review the transfer and contact you on your number to confirm the shipment.");
    const again = el("button", { type: "button" }, "Continue shopping");
    again.addEventListener("click", () => { $("result").hidden = true; showShop("products"); });
    $("result").append(again);
    Object.keys(cart).forEach((k) => delete cart[k]);
    form.reset(); $("preview").style.display = "none"; $("fileName").textContent = "";
    initMethod();
    promoPct = 0; promoCode = ""; $("promo").value = ""; $("promoMsg").textContent = "";
    update();
  } catch (e) {
    console.warn(e);
    const summary = [
      "New Order " + id, "Name: " + info.name, "Phone: " + info.phone, "Governorate: " + info.gov,
      "Address: " + info.address, itemsText, "Total: " + fmt(info.total), "Payment: " + info.method
    ].join("\n");
    showResult("bad", "We were unable to process your order. Please send a photo of the payment transfer and your order details via WhatsApp or Instagram.", summary);
    const why = el("p", { class: "note" }, "Technical reason: " + (e && e.message ? e.message : e));
    why.style.direction = "ltr";
    $("result").append(why);
  }
  btn.disabled = false; btn.textContent = "Confirm";
});

/* =====================================================================
   لوحة الأدمن (3 ضغطات على سطر © في الفوتر)
   ===================================================================== */

let adminPw = "", editingId = "";
const showEl = (e, on) => e.classList.toggle("show", on);

let tapCount = 0, tapTimer;
$("adminTrigger").addEventListener("click", () => {
  tapCount++;
  clearTimeout(tapTimer);
  tapTimer = setTimeout(() => (tapCount = 0), 1500);
  if (tapCount >= 3) {
    tapCount = 0;
    if (adminPw) openPanel();
    else { showEl($("loginModal"), true); $("adminPw").focus(); }
  }
});

async function doLogin() {
  const pw = $("adminPw").value;
  if (!pw) return;
  $("loginErr").textContent = "";
  $("loginBtn").disabled = true;
  try {
    if (!apiReady()) throw new Error("لازم تحط رابط Apps Script في API_URL الأول");
    await api({ action: "login", password: pw });
    adminPw = pw; $("adminPw").value = "";
    showEl($("loginModal"), false);
    openPanel();
  } catch (e) { $("loginErr").textContent = "❌ " + e.message; }
  $("loginBtn").disabled = false;
}
$("loginBtn").addEventListener("click", doLogin);
$("adminPw").addEventListener("keydown", (e) => { if (e.key === "Enter") doLogin(); });
$("loginCancel").addEventListener("click", () => { showEl($("loginModal"), false); $("adminPw").value = ""; $("loginErr").textContent = ""; });

async function openPanel() {
  showEl($("adminPanel"), true);
  document.body.style.overflow = "hidden";
  switchTab("prod");
  await loadProducts();
  renderAdminProducts();
}
function closePanel() { showEl($("adminPanel"), false); document.body.style.overflow = ""; }
$("adminClose").addEventListener("click", closePanel);
$("adminLogout").addEventListener("click", () => { adminPw = ""; closePanel(); });

function switchTab(t) {
  document.querySelectorAll(".tab").forEach((b) => b.classList.toggle("active", b.dataset.tab === t));
  $("tabProd").hidden = t !== "prod";
  $("tabOrd").hidden = t !== "ord";
  $("tabSet").hidden = t !== "set";
  if (t === "ord") loadOrders();
}
document.querySelectorAll(".tab").forEach((b) => b.addEventListener("click", () => switchTab(b.dataset.tab)));

/* ----- المنتجات ----- */

CATEGORIES.forEach(([v, label]) => $("pKind").append(el("option", { value: v }, label)));

$("pImage").addEventListener("change", () => {
  const f = $("pImage").files[0];
  const pv = $("pPreview");
  if (f) { pv.src = URL.createObjectURL(f); pv.style.display = "block"; } else pv.style.display = "none";
});

function resetProductForm() {
  editingId = "";
  ["pName", "pPrice", "pOld"].forEach((i) => ($(i).value = ""));
  $("pKind").value = CATEGORIES[0][0];
  $("pImage").value = ""; $("pPreview").style.display = "none";
  $("pFormTitle").textContent = "إضافة منتج جديد";
  $("pCancel").hidden = true;
  $("pMsg").textContent = "";
}
$("pCancel").addEventListener("click", resetProductForm);

function renderAdminProducts() {
  const box = $("aProdList");
  box.textContent = "";
  if (!PRODUCTS.length) {
    box.append(el("p", { class: "note" }, "مفيش منتجات لسه. ضيف أول منتج من الفورم اللي فوق."));
    return;
  }
  PRODUCTS.forEach((p) => {
    const row = el("div", { class: "a-prod" });
    const img = el("img", { alt: p.name });
    img.onerror = () => { img.onerror = null; img.src = placeholderImg(p); };
    img.src = p.img || placeholderImg(p);
    const info = el("div");
    const cat = (CATEGORIES.find((c) => c[0] === p.kind) || [0, p.kind])[1];
    info.append(el("b", null, p.name), el("div", { class: "note" }, cat + " — " + fmt(p.price) + (p.old ? " (كان " + fmt(p.old) + ")" : "")));
    const acts = el("div", { class: "row-btns" });
    const ed = el("button", { type: "button", class: "ghost" }, "تعديل");
    const del = el("button", { type: "button", class: "ghost danger" }, "حذف");
    ed.addEventListener("click", () => {
      editingId = p.id;
      $("pName").value = p.name; $("pPrice").value = p.price; $("pOld").value = p.old || "";
      $("pKind").value = p.kind; $("pImage").value = ""; $("pPreview").src = p.img; $("pPreview").style.display = "block";
      $("pFormTitle").textContent = "تعديل: " + p.name;
      $("pCancel").hidden = false;
      $("pFormBox").scrollIntoView({ behavior: "smooth", block: "start" });
    });
    del.addEventListener("click", async () => {
      if (!confirm("متأكد إنك عايز تحذف «" + p.name + "»؟")) return;
      del.disabled = true;
      try { await api({ action: "deleteProduct", password: adminPw, id: p.id }); await loadProducts(); renderAdminProducts(); }
      catch (e) { alert(e.message); del.disabled = false; }
    });
    acts.append(ed, del);
    row.append(img, info, acts);
    box.append(row);
  });
}

$("pSave").addEventListener("click", async () => {
  const name = $("pName").value.trim(), price = Number($("pPrice").value), old = Number($("pOld").value) || 0;
  const f = $("pImage").files[0];
  const msg = $("pMsg");
  msg.className = "err"; msg.textContent = "";
  if (!name || !(price > 0)) { msg.textContent = "اكتب اسم المنتج والسعر"; return; }
  if (!editingId && !f) { msg.textContent = "اختار صورة للمنتج"; return; }
  $("pSave").disabled = true; $("pSave").textContent = "جاري الحفظ…";
  try {
    const payload = { action: "saveProduct", password: adminPw, product: { id: editingId, name, price, old, kind: $("pKind").value } };
    if (f) payload.image = await fileToJpeg(f, 1000, 0.85);
    await api(payload);
    resetProductForm();
    await loadProducts();
    renderAdminProducts();
    msg.className = "ok-text"; msg.textContent = "✅ تم الحفظ";
  } catch (e) { msg.textContent = "❌ " + e.message; }
  $("pSave").disabled = false; $("pSave").textContent = "حفظ المنتج";
});

/* ----- الأوردرات ----- */

let sheetUrl = "";
async function loadOrders() {
  const box = $("aOrdList");
  box.textContent = "";
  box.append(el("p", { class: "note" }, "جاري التحميل…"));
  try {
    const d = await api({ action: "listOrders", password: adminPw });
    sheetUrl = d.sheetUrl;
    box.textContent = "";
    if (!d.orders.length) { box.append(el("p", { class: "note" }, "مفيش أوردرات لسه.")); return; }
    d.orders.forEach((o) => {
      const card = el("div", { class: "a-order" });
      const top = el("div", { class: "d-row" });
      top.append(el("b", null, o.id), el("span", { class: "note" }, o.date));
      const t = el("div");
      t.append(el("div", null, "👤 " + o.name + " — " + o.phone), el("div", null, "📍 " + o.gov + " — " + o.address),
        el("div", null, "🛍 " + o.items), el("div", null, "💰 " + o.total + " EGP" + (o.promo ? " (كود " + o.promo + ")" : "") + " — " + o.method + (o.txref ? " — #" + o.txref : "")));
      const holder = el("div");
      if (o.receiptId) {
        const vb = el("button", { type: "button", class: "ghost" }, "عرض صورة التحويل");
        vb.addEventListener("click", async () => {
          vb.disabled = true; vb.textContent = "جاري التحميل…";
          try {
            const r = await api({ action: "receipt", password: adminPw, id: o.receiptId });
            const im = el("img", { alt: "receipt" });
            im.src = "data:" + r.mime + ";base64," + r.data;
            vb.replaceWith(im);
          } catch (e) { vb.textContent = "❌ " + e.message; vb.disabled = false; }
        });
        holder.append(vb);
      }
      card.append(top, t, holder);
      box.append(card);
    });
  } catch (e) { box.textContent = ""; box.append(el("p", { class: "err" }, "❌ " + e.message)); }
}
$("pwSave").addEventListener("click", async () => {
  const a = $("pwNew").value, b = $("pwNew2").value, m = $("pwMsg");
  m.className = "err"; m.textContent = "";
  if (a.length < 6) { m.textContent = "كلمة السر لازم تكون 6 على الأقل"; return; }
  if (a !== b) { m.textContent = "الكلمتين مش زي بعض"; return; }
  $("pwSave").disabled = true;
  try {
    await api({ action: "changePassword", password: adminPw, newPassword: a });
    adminPw = a; $("pwNew").value = ""; $("pwNew2").value = "";
    m.className = "ok-text"; m.textContent = "✅ اتغيرت. استخدم الكلمة الجديدة المرة الجاية.";
  } catch (e) { m.textContent = "❌ " + e.message; }
  $("pwSave").disabled = false;
});
$("ordRefresh").addEventListener("click", loadOrders);
$("ordSheet").addEventListener("click", () => { if (sheetUrl) window.open(sheetUrl, "_blank", "noopener"); else alert("اضغط تحديث الأول"); });
$("ordXlsx").addEventListener("click", async () => {
  const b = $("ordXlsx");
  b.disabled = true; const old = b.textContent; b.textContent = "جاري التجهيز…";
  try {
    const d = await api({ action: "exportXlsx", password: adminPw });
    const bin = atob(d.data), arr = new Uint8Array(bin.length);
    for (let i = 0; i < bin.length; i++) arr[i] = bin.charCodeAt(i);
    const blob = new Blob([arr], { type: "application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet" });
    const a = document.createElement("a");
    a.href = URL.createObjectURL(blob); a.download = d.filename; document.body.append(a); a.click(); a.remove();
    setTimeout(() => URL.revokeObjectURL(a.href), 5000);
  } catch (e) { alert("❌ " + e.message); }
  b.disabled = false; b.textContent = old;
});

document.addEventListener("keydown", (e) => {
  if (e.key !== "Escape") return;
  closeDrawer();
  hideAdded();
  showEl($("loginModal"), false);
});

/* ---------- Start ---------- */

const navLogo = document.querySelector(".nav-logo img");
if (navLogo && $("heroLogo")) $("heroLogo").src = navLogo.src;

/* ظهور العناصر مع السكرول */
(function () {
  const items = document.querySelectorAll(".rv");
  if (!("IntersectionObserver" in window)) { items.forEach((e) => e.classList.add("in")); return; }
  const io = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {
    entries.forEach((en) => { if (en.isIntersecting) { en.target.classList.add("in"); io.unobserve(en.target); } });
  }, { threshold: 0.12 });
  items.forEach((e) => io.observe(e));
})();

console.log("Fararh store build 2026-11-25");
renderStatic();
resetProductForm();
update();
loadProducts();

</script>
</body>
</html>
